Container.Name: logshed
Container.Overview: LogShed is a lightweight, single-process syslog and Docker log aggregator featuring real-time virtualized streaming, SQLite FTS5 search, and user-initiated AI root-cause analysis.

Config.Name: Web UI & REST API
Config.Description: Web UI and REST API port.

Config.Name: Syslog Ingestion (UDP)
Config.Description: Syslog UDP ingestion port (RFC 3164 and RFC 5424).

Config.Name: Application Data
Config.Description: Location for SQLite database (logs.db, WAL, SHM) and encryption master key. Direct cache pool path (/mnt/cache/appdata/logshed or /mnt/pool_name/appdata/logshed) MUST be used instead of /mnt/user/ to ensure POSIX locking and mmap support for SQLite WAL mode.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Host Docker socket for automated container discovery and log streaming (read-only).

Config.Name: Internal Log Level
Config.Description: Minimum severity level for LogShed internal application logs captured into LogShed (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL, or DISABLED).
